_readme: Hand-maintained corrections applied on top of wiki-items.snapshot.json when
build-item-catalog.js produces items.canonical.json. This file is the ONLY
one in the pipeline a human should edit; the snapshot and the canonical file
are both regenerated and will lose manual edits.
Keys are canonical ids (slug of the wiki page title). Values are a partial
item, deep-merged over the generated entry, plus a mandatory `comment`
explaining why the override exists. An entry whose key does not exist in the
snapshot is admitted as a new catalog item.
Setting `stringId` flips matchMethod to `override` and reviewed to true —
so only do it when you have actually confirmed the stringID resolves in
Never put a guessed stringID here: Phase 2.2 writes these into a save.

shopkeepers-goods-bag.comment: Wiki page is 'Shopkeepers goods bag'; gamedata calls the same backpack 'Shopkeeper goods bag' (singular). Verified: gamedataService.lookup('1389-gamedata.base') -> { name: 'Shopkeeper goods bag', type: 46 }, and no other catalog entry claims that stringID. Too far apart for the conservative normaliser (which only folds case, apostrophes and punctuation) to join on its own.
